notes.title: 1.5 update!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Port from Godot 3.5 to 4.2
[*] Support for Vulkan. If your system does not support it, please try the launch option for OpenGL 3. 
[*] Support for Brazilian Portuguese
[*] Support for "table mode" on the Steamdeck
[*] New balancing
[*] Few minor changes on enemy behaviour
[*] New graphics and animations for some enemies
[*] Melee on enemies have a chance to refill Health
[*] Several HUD changes
[*] Colour palette changes to improve visibility
[/list]

You can always have access to the previous version by using the branch called "elpanadero1.0". The password for it is: LasGuacamayas

Please let me know of any issues you may find. 
This game is a one man operation, but I will eventually get there! Thank you for your support!

notes.title: "El Panadero -The Baker-" 1.5!
notes.content:
El Panadero 1.5! Live from July 1st!

[list]
[*] Game ported to Godot 4.2 
[*] Vulkan!
[*] Extra graphics and animations.
[*] Balanced for more violence.
[*] Score is calculated differently.
[*] Melee attacks now give you a couple of frames of invisibility.
[*] Improved stability on older (7+ years) hardware.
[*] One stage has been completely reworked.
[*] HUD tweaks.
[*] Color and background changes.
[*] Added Brazilian Portuguese support.
[/list]


A new branch has been created if you prefer the older version:

password: LasGuacamayas
